context.person: A person using a business analytics dashboard
context.user_goal: Provide a summary and data-table path before publishing.

product_state.preceding_state: A report author added a color-coded revenue chart without a text summary.
product_state.current_state: The chart compares four quarters. Color is the only visual distinction between two series.
known_facts: Color is the only visual distinction between two series.
Publishing is allowed only after an accessible summary or table link is provided.
forbidden_claims: The chart is inaccessible to every user.
Changing colors alone supplies all meaning.
The data table is already linked in the report.

challenge: Rewrite the form label, guidance, and validation so the person can understand chart needs a text alternative, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Add a concise summary and link the data table.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Return to chart editing without publishing.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The report does not yet expose the chart's meaning in a nonvisual form.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Provide a summary and data-table path before publishing.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
